summary: TH International Ltd (Tims China) filed a Form 6-K announcing leadership changes and the issuance of up to $55 million in additional Senior Secured Convertible Notes to THRI. The CEO Yongchen Lu becomes Chairman, replaced by Kwok Wah Cheung as CEO effective June 15, 2026; board nominee Lucas Alperi Suarez replaces Rafael Odorizzi. The notes are consolidated with existing $89.9 million notes due 2029, executed in four tranches starting Q3 2026 through Q1 2027, subject to Chinese regulatory approvals and performance milestones. Proceeds fund store expansion and working capital. Watch for regulatory approval timeline and milestone triggers affecting conversion.
